decisions.reason: Adding and presenting the functional and overall dimensions does not change the assembly-aligned drawing-numbering rule.
The dimension-content decision does not replace or modify the client-supplied drawing setup reference.
The source changes dimension content and presentation, not the color rules for drawing views.
The dimension change does not alter the PDF-first confirmation sequence, which is independently established by another clause in the same message.
The dimension decision does not change drawing file formats; the same message's separate deliverables clause is already represented by the candidate's MODIFY Event.
Adding a functional dimension and retaining the overall dimension does not change the requirement to follow the usual ČSN/EN standards.
The source does not change the specified surface-finish value or tolerance-field usage.
The drawing-dimension clarification does not modify the bushing's location, retention, fit, motion, or rod-guidance arrangement.
The distance between the indicated holes is unrelated to the thread-relief groove's presence, location, or unresolved width.
The source does not alter the locking thread geometry or the 65 mm main-bushing space.
Requiring the distance between indicated holes to appear as a drawing dimension does not change the requirement to retain the bushing and sliding-mandrel holes.
The drawing-dimension decision does not affect the 3D model formats; the same message's separate deliverables clause is already fully represented by the candidate's MODIFY Event.
